claims: /design takes the best of the Claude Design web app and inserts it into Claude Code; no more bouncing between apps or zip transfers
Inside Claude Design web app you cannot invoke Impeccable or Taste; inside Claude Code you can
Desktop app renders the artboard in a side panel; terminal opens it as a browser artifact
A 'Tweaks' panel starts empty; you prompt Claude to add tweakable controls (color, text size, weight, leading)
Visual iteration is much faster than prompt -> wait -> check -> prompt loops
Creator updates the masterclass every week
how_to_steps: Run /design with a prompt (demo: Instagram post explaining /design, 3 very different styles, invoke Impeccable)
Step 1 Inspiration: screenshot 3 designs you like from Pinterest / Land-book / Dribbble and build a reusable reference library
Step 2 Skills: drop the screenshots into the prompt, ask for one generation per screenshot, tell it to use Impeccable and to use Higgsfield MCP (or fal.ai) if it needs outside assets
Step 3 Iterate: ask Claude to 'add aggressive tweakable controls' so the Tweaks panel exposes paper color, type size, weight, leading etc.
Narrow to one variant ('ignore the other two, focus on the metal one'), ask for content changes, have it web-search to get facts right
Keep iterating until satisfied, then use/implement the result
